currentEtLStatus.advisoryStatus: Rhode Island now has parser-backed same-key President-versus-U.S.-Senate review rows. Advisory indicators are source-review calculations only, not findings.

certifiedResults.caveat: The archive also contains earlier nested setup/results snapshots, so scripts/normalize-ri-boe-results.mjs requires the finalized root rigen2024l.txt member explicitly. That member exactly matches posted statewide JSON. The native importer aggregates official city/town rows to five county rows; Federal Precincts remains non-geographic and is not mapped.

sameGrainComparisonContest.preferredContest: U.S. Senate, same official 2024 General Election long-format ZIP source family as President.
sameGrainComparisonContest.caveat: U.S. Senate is the preferred statewide comparison contest. The explicit finalized root ZIP member exactly matches posted statewide JSON; 39 presidential-only rows and 14 zero-vote same-key rows are not included in the 444 nonzero paired review rows.

stateNativeTurnout.sourceAuthority: U.S. Election Assistance Commission; Rhode Island Board of Elections; Rhode Island Department of State
stateNativeTurnout.reportingGrain: EAC jurisdiction fallback remains active; official SOS Data Hub rows are city/town-plus-precinct, party, and registration status.
stateNativeTurnout.parserNeeded: scripts/normalize-ri-registration-datahub.mjs reproduces the official public Power BI query, hash-pins its response, and retains status-separated city/town-and-precinct registration rows. Keep eacTurnoutCsv active until compatible official ballots-cast or voter-participation semantics are collected and reconciled.
stateNativeTurnout.caveat: The 2024-11-01 snapshot is the closest monthly Data Hub date to the General Election. Its default report page filters Active voters, while the normalized denominator lead preserves Active, Inactive, and Pending separately. It includes no compatible ballots-cast or voter-participation field, and its all-status registration total is 794 above EAC.

geometryAndCrosswalk.caveat: Current RI county map capability is enabled by aggregating official city/town rows to county totals. Federal Precincts is retained as non-geographic and excluded from map joins; city/town and precinct overlays still need result-ready geometry or crosswalks.

historicalBaselines.caveat: The 2020 ZIP contains earlier nested setup/results snapshots in addition to the finalized root rigen2020l.asc member. The normalizer requires the root member explicitly and validates each year against official statewide JSON totals. A read-only production API audit accepted the intentional display-grain replacement after reconciling every county/Federal Precincts vote bucket with zero delta; promotion remains a separate coordinator action.
historicalBaselines.notes: 2012, 2016, and 2020 BOE historical rows are aggregated from city/town rows to five county-tagged rows per year, with one Federal Precincts row per year retained as non-geographic and unforced for county FIPS joins.

promotionAcceptance.liveProfile: 86 rows: 40 municipal/federal in 2012, 40 municipal/federal in 2016, and 6 county/federal in 2020
promotionAcceptance.stagedProfile: 18 rows: five canonical county tags plus unforced Federal Precincts for each of 2012, 2016, and 2020
promotionAcceptance.voteReconciliation: Zero Democratic, Republican, Other, or total-vote delta statewide and for every county/Federal Precincts bucket in all three years.
promotionAcceptance.displayChange: The Historical tab/API/export will replace 39 municipal labels with five county labels in 2012 and 2016; 2020 labels and all statewide summaries are unchanged.
promotionAcceptance.flipImpact: Kent County is the sole RI red-to-blue flip for 2016-to-2020 and 2016-to-2024; RI has no 2020-to-2024 county flip.

sourceAcquisitionDecision.reason: The official RI.gov Board of Elections results app publishes ZIP and JSON result files. The parser now requires finalized root ZIP members, producing exact 2024 President and U.S. Senate totals plus county-tagged 2012/2016/2020 historical baselines.

websiteAndApiDisplayPath.currentPath: Rhode Island staging/API path has native result, review, EAC turnout fallback, and complete 2012/2016/2020 county-aggregated historical rows through etl/state-configs/ri.json.
websiteAndApiDisplayPath.observedDifference: Production exposes 86 historical rows; staging exposes 18. The Historical tab groups County Movement by jurisdictionName, draws per-row fingerprint/diagnostic panels, reports row counts, and exports the same API rows, so 2012/2016 will intentionally change from municipal to canonical county display grain.

remainingRisks: The official 2020 and 2024 ZIPs retain earlier nested setup/results snapshots alongside finalized root members; the parser must continue requiring the explicit finalized root entries.
Review rows exclude 14 zero-vote same-key rows and 39 presidential-only rows that lack a same-key U.S. Senate comparison.

EAC fallback turnout is active. The SOS Data Hub 2024-11-01 registration lead is normalized at city/town-and-precinct grain but includes no compatible ballots-cast or voter-participation field; its 792,869 all-status registrations are 794 above EAC, so it is not an active-turnout replacement.

County map rows are generated from official city/town totals; city/town, precinct, district, mail, early-vote, and polling-place labels still need geometry/crosswalk review before finer map overlays are enabled.
No normalized 2024 audit, recount, CVR, incident, correction, or litigation rows are loaded.
All advisory indicator rows are source-review calculations, not findings of fraud or misconduct.
